name: Takase Tsubasa
source:
Seiran Academy, Third year

He's Shuntaro's upper class mentor. It's said that his skill at basketball is beyond that of a high school student. Cheerful and with a strong sense of fair play, he's very popular.

[From [url=http://www.joinac.com/GAS/graduation/English/chara/index.html]official site[/url]]
